inputs.name: t_hop, C_t, C_s, D
inputs.note: Chapter couplings, fitted for A<=3 in the 6^3 box. Not refitted for A>=12 or for 8^3.

inputs.name: time grid
inputs.note: Kept. q = 2 pi/(8a) = 110.7 MeV on 8^3.

inputs.name: shots
inputs.note: Hoeffding plus union bound; +-0.05 (2 estimates) and +-0.02 (6 estimates), 95% simultaneous.

inputs.name: system register
inputs.note: Labeled triton: (3m+1) A = 30.

inputs.name: Lemma 1, Lemma 3, Thm 2-5, App. A, Eqs. (90), (108), (217)
inputs.note: Implemented in spagnoli_lemmas.py; Table 5 reproduced (README section 2).

inputs.name: 1 us per T, 0.1 ms per shot, 0.1 faults per shot
inputs.note: Serial T count on one machine; no T-depth derived.

inputs.name: spin-dependent contact, exclusive-pair form
inputs.note: Equal to the chapter's on-site interaction on antisymmetric states; all terms commute. Circuit is a construction-level count, not compiled.

inputs.name: potential layer counts
inputs.note: Three equality sweeps; compute and uncompute both counted at 7 T per Toffoli.

inputs.name: kinetic layer counts (8^3)
inputs.source: scoping.py kinetic_layer; Walsh count in spin_contact_check.py
inputs.note: Exact QFT_8 (2 CS + 1 CT each way) and 4 controlled Walsh phases for the hopping dispersion.

inputs.name: kinetic layer counts (6^3)
inputs.note: CRT relabeling, generic two-qubit QFT_3; no circuit constructed.

inputs.name: generalized alpha_2 for C_t != C_s
inputs.value: Eq. (217) with C -> Cbar and +|dC| terms
inputs.note: Our extension of the paper's semi-norm bound; hopping dispersion uses max single-particle kinetic energy 12 t.

inputs.name: block-encoding norm
inputs.note: Paper Eq. (90) form with hopping kinetic LCU and a pair-SWAP LCU. The paper leaves the SWAP block encoding to future work.

inputs.name: spin SELECT cost
inputs.note: Second swap network and comparator; construction-level, self-inverse property not verified.

inputs.name: Slater-determinant preparation
inputs.value: A^2 orbital unitaries, A(A-1)/2 swap+C^kX, A^2-4A+3 rotations
inputs.note: Each orbital unitary costed here as a 511-rotation real loader on 9 spatial qubits (Computed).

inputs.name: eigenstate filter degree
inputs.note: Needs E_0 known to much better than the gap. That knowledge is Assumed.

inputs.name: evolution error target
inputs.note: Half the +-0.02 tolerance; chapter measured 0.0073. T scales as eps^-1/2 (PF) or log (QSP).

inputs.name: PF step count, calibrated
inputs.note: No A>=12 numerics exist. Range: this value up to the rigorous bound (60-110 times more steps).

inputs.name: PF step count, bound
inputs.note: Worst-case semi-norm; 100 times above the triton's measured need.

inputs.name: ground-state gap
inputs.source: physical first excited states as proxies
inputs.note: The model's finite-volume gap is unknown. Range 1-8 MeV; LO pionless nuclei may sit near cluster thresholds.

inputs.name: mean-field overlap squared
inputs.note: Range 1e-3 to 0.5. Sets attempts per accepted shot.

inputs.name: filter infidelity
inputs.note: Enters logarithmically.

inputs.name: rodeo filter time
inputs.note: Product-formula route only. Constants from the published cycle factor; schedule not optimized.

inputs.name: charge-operator LCU norm
inputs.note: Antisymmetrized registers carry no proton label. Isoscalar density has factor 1.

inputs.name: qubitized-route extra qubits
inputs.note: Second unary register and flags; not laid out.
